referenceInterpretation: Show recognizable physical objects, their surroundings, clearance/access space, and dimension arrows terminating on the stated reference features. Plans, elevations, sections, annotated photography and restrained 3D rendering fit. A numeric comparison chart alone does not satisfy this physical illustration brief. Reference-image measurements are not evidence for the live article.
article: Minimum clearances between power facilities and other utilities

automatedReview.method: Separate model call reviewing SVG code against live paragraph evidence; not rendered vision.

primaryAgentReview.verdict: Pass as an object-based 2D engineering illustration. This meets the spatial intent of the supplied examples substantially better than the retired bar chart.
observed: One figure contains two clearly separate underground examples, rather than an invented complete site layout.
The left scene depicts a tree and visible roots. The 1.0 m dimension spans horizontally from the root-edge projection to the nearest side of the orange power-facility symbol.
The right scene depicts the bottom surface of a power facility and the top of another utility. The 0.3 m dimension is drawn vertically between those surfaces.
The caption states mutually agreed minimums, illustrative and not to scale, and preserves the vertical-clearance qualification unless otherwise stipulated.
The figure follows the article paragraph that discusses these relationships. Other numbers were omitted rather than copied from reference images or forced into one drawing.
The authenticated image loads in the actual app. The existing viewer opens it and zooms on a 360px layout; horizontal panning is necessary after zoom.
Live removal hides the figure, and Undo removal restores the same figure. Article paragraphs remain unchanged.
limitations: The power facilities are generic cross-section symbols. This is an explanatory schematic, not a site-specific construction drawing.
The tree is stylized, and the small labels benefit from enlargement on phones.
Raster image generation and licensed online-asset acquisition remain unconnected to the application. This run tests original SVG only.
The primary review checks consistency with stored article text, not independent engineering or regulatory verification.

retiredDirection.verdict: Rejected and retired. Correct comparison values do not substitute for showing physical objects, spaces and measurement endpoints.
